title: Compare Latin-1 backreference without case sensitivity

workload.description: Execute a case-insensitive Latin-1 backreference comparison of bounded length.

validation.details: Assertions passed under Node.js v18.19.1 as a JavaScript behavior check only; this does not verify V8 revision, d8 flags, or marked-region reachability.

tests.coverage_note: The flag keeps supported classic RegExp matching in the bytecode interpreter. Exact entry into the marked internal function remains unverified until the instrumented d8 build is run.
